stop_reason: Q6/PTM/MSD jointly indicated sustained liquid-like disorder in the predefined Ag hot core from 5.0 through 5.5 ps; additional heat-on steps were not needed for the requested local-melting check.
stop_signal: SIGINT sent after step 11560; the final JSON summary in the driver was therefore not emitted. Metrics and trajectory files were flushed before the signal.
source_profile: XY circular Gaussian R=30 A times surface-depth exponential skin=20 A
hot_core_definition: initial Ag atoms with r_xy<=30 A and z>=120 A; 1078 atoms
phase_decision: Hot-core Ag is locally liquid-like by the joint Qbar6, PTM, and COM-corrected MSD trends. This does not establish bulk melting or a thermodynamic melting point. The initial geometry was unrelaxed and already had only 7.70% PTM-FCC in this hot-core mask; the 2.22 A minimum Ag-Ag distance also warrants caution.
